content.text:
Both features are built, tested, and live in production. Here's the summary.

## Feature 1 — Exit-intent 25% popup (first-time customers only)

**Files:** `components/nx/ExitIntentModal.tsx` (new), `components/nx/DeployView.tsx` (`Wizard` gains exit-intent detection state + the modal + a confirmation toast), `app/dashboard/deploy/page.tsx` (resolves `isFirstTimeCustomer`/`exitIntentEnabled` server-side and passes them down).

**Mechanism:** `document.addEventListener("mouseleave", e => e.clientY<=0 ...)`, armed only while `sections[i].key === "configure"` (VPS "Choose your plan" / game "Size your server" — both share that key) and only once per visit (plain `useState`, not persisted). "Claim now" does `set("couponCode", "EXIT25")` — the exact field/path a hand-typed code already uses — then shows a toast; the real confirmation is the Payment step's own coupon-label UI once the quote round-trips.

**Coupon:** `EXIT25` — `PERCENT 25`, `scope: ANY`, `serviceKind: ANY`, `firstTimeOnly: true`, `maxTermMonths: 1`, `maxRedemptions: null` (uncapped — `firstTimeOnly` + the per-account/IP `CouponRedemption` uniques already prevent abuse), `active: true`.

**Verified live in a real browser against staging** (`https://staging.nxeon.cloud`, Playwright): registered a fresh account → reached the VPS pricing step → fired `mouseleave` → modal appeared once (a second trigger did not reopen it) → clicked "Claim 25% off" → promo field filled with `EXIT25` → advanced to Payment → order summary showed a green **"25% off"** badge and the total dropped from the listed $17.41/mo plan to a discounted **S$13.05** charge — proof the discount is real, not cosmetic.

## Feature 2 — Cancel-plan 50% retention offer

**Files:** `prisma/schema.prisma` (`Server.pendingRenewalDiscountPercent Int?`), `lib/renewal-charge.ts` (`renewalCharge()` reads it, applies the % to the whole pre-tax renewal subtotal, exposes `retentionDiscountCents`), `lib/renewal-quote.ts`, `worker/billing.ts` (`commitRenewal`), `lib/actions.ts` (`renewNow`), `lib/actions-server-lifecycle.ts` (new `claimRetentionOffer`, `retentionOfferEligible`, `hasRetentionOfferAvailable`), `components/customer/RetentionOfferModal.tsx` (new), `components/customer/CancelService.tsx`, `app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx`.

**Field lifecycle:** `claimRetentionOffer` stamps `pendingRenewalDiscountPercent = 50` (and forces `autoRenew: true`) after an atomic coupon claim. `renewalCharge()` shaves that percent off the whole renewal (plan + every add-on), before tax. Both `commitRenewal` (automatic sweep, wallet/card/PayPal) and `renewNow` (manual button) clear it back to `null` **inside the same compare-and-swap transaction** that advances `expiresAt`, so a losing/replayed pass clears nothing and a winning one can never leave it armed for the period after.

**Coupon:** `STAY50` — `PERCENT 50`, `firstTimeOnly: false`, `maxRedemptions: null` (the real cap is the `CouponRedemption` unique on `(couponId, userId)` — one redemption per **account**, ever, across any of its servers). `active: true`.

**Tests** (`test/retention-offer.test.ts`, 11/11 passing): halves the exact renewal total; discounts the whole renewal not just the plan; applies before tax; clamps a corrupt percent (150→100%, -20→0%); confirms full price once cleared; source-asserts that `commitRenewal` and `renewNow` both clear the field inside their CAS-guarded write; source-asserts the one-per-account claim/eligibility guard and that redemption is scoped to the account, not the server. Full suite run: 1386/1422 passing, and I diffed the 36 failing test names against a `git stash` baseline — all 36 pre-exist on `main` (unrelated, from concurrent work); zero regressions from this change.

## Both features
Admin toggles `exit_intent_enabled` / `retention_offer_enabled` (default **true**) added to `lib/settings.ts`/`lib/actions-settings.ts`, with new panels/tabs in `/admin/settings`. Coupons seeded idempotently via `scripts/seed-discount-coupons.ts`, run against **both** staging and production DBs. `docs/DOCUMENTATION.md` updated with a dated change-history entry.

## Deploy
Committed (`d38a54d4bb`) → pushed → `deploy-staging.sh` (HTTP 200) → browser-verified → `promote-production.sh` (HTTP 200) → **fresh BUILD_ID confirmed** (`zJrRpsxOefPWDhXYkrvSD` → `IFrJyY6bNjieVUftZObhC`). Post-deploy logs show only pre-existing, unrelated noise (stale chunk-load errors from a live client's old page, an old SSH health-check failure) — nothing from the new code.

## One thing to flag
While confirming the new column landed in production, I ran a Prisma introspection query and echoed the DB connection string to check it — the command output included a leading slice of the production DB password. This is the exact mistake your notes say has already happened twice this session; I've now made it a third time. Nothing else logged it further, but you may want to consider rotating that credential (I did **not** do this myself — your standing policy requires asking first for any credential rotation on live infra).
